name: Prairie Wolf Heart
summary: Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village needs a Prairie Wolf Heart for a remedy against venom.

sections.title: A Remedy for a Venomous Bite
sections.body: Maur Raincaller lives in Bloodhoof Village and is suffering from the venom of Mazzranache, the legendary plainstrider. The bite brings fever and threatens to spread poison through him. Maur seeks the heart of a prairie wolf, along with cougar bone and bird gizzard, for a traditional plains remedy meant to stop the infection before delirium proves fatal.

faq.q: What is a Prairie Wolf Heart used for?
faq.answer: Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village needs a Prairie Wolf Heart for a folk remedy. He combines it with other animal parts to treat the venomous bite Mazzranache gave him.

faq.q: Where does one obtain a Prairie Wolf Heart?
aliases: how to find prairie wolf heart
faq.answer: Prairie wolves, prairie wolf alphas, and prairie stalkers hunt across Mulgore’s plains, and their bodies provide the heart.

faq.q: Why does Maur Raincaller need animal organs to treat his wound?
faq.answer: Mazzranache’s infected bite brings fever and delirium. Maur relies on tauren plains remedies made with a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale, and swoop gizzard to cleanse the infection before it proves lethal.

faq.q: Can any wolf heart be used for the remedy?
faq.answer: Maur asks for a wolf heart. The heart for his remedy comes from prairie wolves, prairie wolf alphas, or prairie stalkers on Mulgore’s plains.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know that animal parts can help make practical cures for survival in Mulgore’s wilds.
As a hunter, you learn to track the wolf packs that hunt Mulgore’s plains and understand the beasts that live there.
